totalClaimed.gta.wiki Achievements_and_Trophies_in_GT: 43 Social Club achievements (incl. Kingpin), 9 SC-exclusive, 33 shared gameplay achievements; table has 43 rows. Own arithmetic does not reconcile (33+9=42, +Kingpin=43)

conflicts: Count: 43 rows total on gta.wiki and gtabase (33 shared + Kingpin + 9 extras). gta.wiki text says '33 gameplay + 43 SC' and '9 SC-exclusive'; 33+9=42, so the 43rd is Kingpin. gtabase header says '42 (+1 Platinum)'. Resolved only as an inference: 43 including Kingpin.

Whether the 9 extras are Social Club-only: gta.wiki marks them SC-exclusive; gtabase page does not label them. The earlier scout said gtabase called them SC; the fetched page does not. gta.wiki Retro Lewk page also calls it a PS trophy/Xbox achievement, contradicting 'SC-exclusive'.

Kingpin: gta.wiki Kingpin page says it needs all other 42 SC achievements 'in the same playthrough' - odd claim, single source, low confidence. Description 'Unlock all achievements.' (SC/Xbox) vs 'Unlock all trophies.' (PS).
City Sleuth PS tier: gtabase (Xbox 55 pts => Gold) vs PowerPyx (Silver).

Wording: Offender 'wanted starts' (both sources, apparent typo). Target Practice 'Perform 50 headshots' (gta.wiki, gtabase) vs 'Land 50 headshots' (GameRevolution leak via earlier scout). 'Done it All' period inconsistent. 'Mission 'G-Spotlight'' vs '"G-Spotlight"'.
PS tiers: gtabase tier is derived from Xbox points (Bronze/Silver/Gold per gamerscore); not confirmed against PSNProfiles.
switchNotes: No source directly states the Switch version's Social Club accomplishments list. A search summary said they appear shared across platforms (inferred from Kingpin entry only). User has confirmed their Rockstar account tracks them, which is the stronger evidence.

No entry obviously references content absent on Switch. Unverified candidates: Don't Need Roads (Deluxo), Vice Vice Baby (new DE dealer subgame), Retro Lewk (outfit count unknown), Take the Cannoli (patch 1.02 threshold on Switch).
gaps: Could not fetch socialclub.rockstargames.com, Epic store achievements page (403), progameguides (403), trueachievements, PowerPyx or PSNProfiles directly. All descriptions rest on gta.wiki and gtabase, which may share lineage (not independent).
No source verified the exact Social Club in-game tracker UI or whether SC accomplishments display progress counters.
Outfit total for Retro Lewk and property total for Vice City Mogul/Prime Real Estate not confirmed.
Whether Kingpin is a distinct SC accomplishment is not directly verified.
